name: Do kitchen door frame repairs differ between older Denver homes and newer suburban builds?

mainEntity.name: Do kitchen door frame repairs differ between older Denver homes and newer suburban builds?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older homes in central Denver neighborhoods often feature non-standard doorway heights, thicker plaster walls, or aged wood trim, while newer developments in areas like Centennial and Parker frequently use standard drywall and modern pre-hung dimensions. In older builds, repairs often require custom-milled jamb extensions and plaster patching rather than off-the-shelf components, demanding finish carpentry skills to match historic profiles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, older central Denver homes often feature custom opening sizes and plaster walls needing milled timber, while newer suburban homes use standard-dimension framing.
